metadata.description: SORP team plugins: process registry review and runnable process models with scenario runs, shared questions and the simulation stand.

plugins.name: sorp-processy
plugins.description: Builds a runnable model of a SORP map process, derives and runs every test scenario, publishes open questions to a shared page, applies answers back and releases models to the simulation stand with UI tests. Code only: map data stays in your working folder.

plugins.name: sorp-svod
plugins.description: Walks the team through business-process gaps in the SORP registry and writes answers back. Asks your name on first run and issues a key. Your questions and button choices are logged to the shared review journal.
